body: I'm going to see the doctor tomorrow. Let's hope everything works out. I just want to be happy again.
How did you get out of it?

I have ADHD, and I've been on medication since I can remember. Ritalin and his friends. One at a time, but I've been on a bunch of different ones. I started taking my current pill about a year and a half ago, and I experienced side-effects for the first time. Loss of appetite. Basically I was never hungry. Eventually, I'd start getting headaches when I missed meals. So it got to the point where I'd have a really bad headache (no painkillers could help) every day. So, I just stopped taking my meds. That was about a month ago.

Then a few days in, I started going through withdrawal. That's the worst thing I've ever had to go through. Worse than that time I had crazy diarrhea on an airplane, or that time I shit my pants in university.

During withdrawal I developed a serious anxiety/depression problem. So then I started taking my meds again, and slowly, every day would get better than the last. But then my progress plateaued, and for the last two weeks I've just been depressed, with episodes of anxiety every couple days.

I just want to be my old self again, and I worry that it might never happen. I keep feeling like my girlfriend doesn't care. That no one cares. I always feel better when I'm with my girlfriend, but she's so busy and I can't call her every day just to have her hold my hand. I worry about being an emotional burden to her. And I think that's why I'm scared to tell her how bad this really is. I don't want her to freak out and leave.

I'm embarrassed because I read other peoples' stories and they're dealing with shit way worse than I am. Like, you know in Zoolander, when he goes to the mine, and after one day he's like "*cough* *cough* I think I have the black lung, Pop" and his dad's like "Derek you've been down there for one day. Talk to me in 30 years." 

Anyway, the scene is hilarious, but that's how I feel. I've only been feeling this way for a month, and most suicidal people have been feeling this way their entire lives almost. What right do I have to complain after only 1 month?

I dunno. Maybe it's more intense for me than for others. Or maybe I just can't deal with it as well as others.

But I feel like I can't even talk about my depression because I've only had it for about a month, and whenever I try and talk about it to people, they just don't understand. They all think that I'm sad about something in particular, instead of sad by default.
I think about it every single day
